race.description: St Johns Park Bowling Club Midway Hcp (Bm64)
race.comment: HE'S GOT GRUNT (4) continued his upward spiral last start, taking out a Class 1 over the mile here after racing handy throughout. Gets to this distance for the first time but he is drawn to get a soft run and loves Hawkesbury. Can make it back-to-back. MY CARTOUCHE (8) took 22 runs but finally cracked the maiden status last start with a gutsy all-the-way win over this course and distance. Should take it up again and with 2kgs less today another cheeky run looks on the cards. MALBORK CASTLE (2) put the writing on the wall last start when he looked a chance but just missed over 1500m at this circuit. Has raced here once at the trip for a win and at the fourth run back he is poised for another big performance. C'MON FLYER (5) worked home well but was beaten comfortably by HE'S GOT GRUNT here last time. Doubt he can turn the tables but a top three finish is in reach.
